exposure: Obstetrician's approach to counseling patients with a previous Cesarean delivery
Personal family experience of Cesarean delivery
Length of time of specialist qualification
outcome: Obstetricians' awareness of factors influencing successful trial of labor after Cesarean delivery
Obstetricians' approach to counseling women on birth choices after Cesarean delivery
Obstetricians' opinions on dedicated trial of labor after Cesarean delivery clinics and legal support
cohort: Obstetricians in the 2 largest state maternity hospitals in Doha, Qatar
finding: Obstetricians had different approaches to counseling for trial of labor after Cesarean delivery, which can influence patient acceptance of trial of labor after Cesarean delivery and affect Cesarean delivery rates.
mod_finding: Obstetricians had differing approaches when counseling patients with a previous cesarean delivery about their mode of delivery for their current pregnancy, which could impact patient acceptance of vaginal birth after cesarean and subsequently affect overall cesarean delivery rates.
